current_owner_report: Brief loading after the Diff'rent logo disappears, then black screen.
source_findings: The Evolution1 heap initializer caller at 0x8c04ed28..0x8c04ed68 initializes the remaining SDK heap beginning at 0x8c35e200, then enters video setup at 0x8c165a4e.
Evolution1 does not match the Lodoss remaining-RAM private-pool split. The selective f158 budget correction therefore leaves it unchanged.
The original game deliberately blanks video during mode setup and waits on SDK video counter 0x8c358d18. Earlier blanking observations did not establish a CPU crash or failed allocation.
Previous original-instruction replay found the Sofdec cache transition and setter equivalent to working Evolution2.

Historical console testing with a 192KiB Standard reservation passed lease-only and failed with active runtime hooks. This makes runtime/video lifecycle a stronger lead than reservation alone, without excluding a later allocation failure under the current 384KiB reservation.

conclusion: No specific production change is justified from the symptom alone. Capture the current interrupted game/video state before changing allocator, IRQ, cache, or VMU hook policy.
